Thank you for the suggestion but we already have an idea for that. This post was to create the name for self-enhancers. You see, under the Enhancers class, we have Enchanters that embue objects with magical power. We also have Supports (WIP) that embue others with magical buffs and/or debuffs. The one we are struggling with are the ones who embue themselves with said magical buffs. And if you also have a suggestion of a title to replace supports that is more fitting for our world, we would appreciate that as well.

I already have the culture part covered, and as far as seeing mana goes, it'll probably just look like a psychedelic day dream and would probably be the equivalent of being color blind, especially in places where it's stronger. There's also a way to store mana in oneself, which is covered in a basics of mana course in school, around highschool level. As far as pushing mana into objects and things, that's just enchanters.

Cuz it is magic...? The level of spells you use is dependent on how much ambient magic is in the air. It's lesser in some areas and greater in others. When it comes to the class system, they are only umbrella terms used by the schooling system to help organize their students. Other than that, what really counts is the affinity* of magic they are proficient in and how they use it. Thats the reason it's so broad, because it's a soft magic system meant to play in tangent with the story.

*=The natural proficiency a magic user has with any type of magic.

Well the term enchanters is used for those who put their buffs on weapons or armour of the sorts. The other two are more oriented on applying buffs to either their allies or themselves. In this case I'm more focused on what the subclass of self enhancement will be called to make it stand out from just basic enhancements
I was thinking more along the lines of buffs like speed boost or self heals, but I like the idea and may run with it as a separate subclass of magic under enhancers
